cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before your taxi comes, let's restart our letters. I've brought paper and stamps. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never answered my last three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The post's been terrible. We can write the first ones here, bypass the whole system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I handed you the last one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Sit down; I'll write yours first. You can watch until there's enough to take home.

mechanism: A confidently directs a letter-writing restart and yields order and oversight to retain B, while deflecting A responsibility for unanswered letters.
confusable: Unlike admitting fault and repairing it, A blames post and then bypasses disproof; borrowed authority keeps issuing an increasingly accommodating plan.
comparison: Urgent writing before taxi differs from restoring home access while avoiding responsibility for changed locks.
